name: Source fir A grove with source normal maps and view-facing cards
physical_size_note: Same actual source fir A and source stem positions as individual_a. Near retains simplified original trunk; foliage/far use source albedo, opacity and actual source geometry normals projected into each card's tangent basis. View-facing alpha suppresses edge-on cards consistently in depth and color. Explicit rendering approximation, no invented plant geometry or baked directional illumination.
